chapters.reason: The paper focuses on generating synthetic continuous CoT to serve as a precise alignment target for LLMs, ensuring semantic fidelity between latent reasoning and explicit CoT.
The paper addresses efficiency by replacing discrete CoT with continuous CoT and uses a difficulty classifier to adaptively re-think hard questions, adjusting reasoning effort.
The framework involves an adaptive re-thinking mechanism for hard questions, which functions as a form of progressive refinement of the reasoning process.
